+"""Vision-guided ee_delta controller for the live Meta-World bin-picking episode.

+def estimate_green_object(obs):
+    """Return a depth-projected world XYZ estimate of the green object center."""
+    rgb = obs.last['topview'].astype(np.int16)
+    # The object is the saturated green patch; the source and destination bins
+    # are red and blue respectively.
+    mask = ((rgb[:, :, 1] > 145) &

+            (rgb[:, :, 1] > rgb[:, :, 2] * 1.35))

+        raise RuntimeError(f'green object not visible in top view (pixels={len(xx)})')
+    depth = obs.depth['topview'][0, yy, xx].astype(np.float64)
+    cam = obs.meta['cameras']['topview']
+    K = np.asarray(cam['intrinsic_cv'], dtype=float)
+    T = np.asarray(cam['cam2world_gl'], dtype=float)
+    # OpenGL camera coordinates: image x right, image y up, view along -z.
+    xc = (xx - K[0, 2]) * depth / K[0, 0]
+    yc = -(yy - K[1, 2]) * depth / K[1, 1]
+    xyz_gl = np.stack((xc, yc, -depth, np.ones_like(depth)), axis=0)
+    world = T @ xyz_gl
+    # Median rejects antialiased border pixels and any small mask contamination.
+    center = np.median(world[:3], axis=1)
+    return center, (int(len(xx)), (int(xx.min()), int(xx.max())), (int(yy.min()), int(yy.max())))
+
+
+def observe(robot, label, seconds=0.0):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=seconds, include_depth=True, video='both')
+    out = OUT / label
+    obs.save(str(out))
+    state = current_state(obs)
+    print('OBS', label, json.dumps({
+        'control_steps': obs.meta.get('control_steps'),
+        'time_left_s': obs.meta.get('time_left_s'),
+        'tcp': [state['tcp_x'], state['tcp_y'], state['tcp_z']],
+        'mocap': [state['mocap_x'], state['mocap_y'], state['mocap_z']],
+        'gripper_opening': state['gripper_opening'],
+        'target_pos': obs.meta['task']['target_pos'],
+    }))
+    return obs
+

+def move_mocap(robot, obs, target, grip=-1.0, max_step_m=0.004):
+    """Move the mocap target along a bounded, smooth ee_delta trajectory."""
+    state = current_state(obs)
+    start = np.array([state['mocap_x'], state['mocap_y'], state['mocap_z']])
+    target = np.asarray(target, dtype=float)
+    delta = target - start
